metadata.title: OIDC redirectUri Protocol-Relative URL Bypass — False Positive

transformations: new URL(res.redirectUri) — NO base parameter — TypeError on protocol-relative input
catch(e) { return; } — aborts redirect on TypeError
sinks: window.location.href — only reachable with syntactically valid absolute HTTPS URL

privilege_boundary.achieved_privilege: None — TypeError thrown for protocol-relative URLs, redirect aborted

impact.description: The protocol-relative bypass is inapplicable: new URL('//evil.com') without a base URL throws TypeError per WHATWG spec. The catch block aborts the redirect. No exploitation is possible via this attack path.

compensating_controls: new URL() without base throws TypeError for relative URLs (WHATWG spec)
catch(e) { return; } aborts redirect on any parse failure

remediation.fix_approach: No fix required for the specific bypass claim. Defense-in-depth: add IdP hostname allowlist validation after URL parsing to guard against full backend compromise.

history.note: redirectUri https: scheme check bypassed by protocol-relative URL '//evil.com' which inherits HTTPS on HTTPS pages
new URL('//evil.com') without base throws TypeError per WHATWG spec — bypass technique inapplicable. catch(e) { return; } aborts redirect. Protocol-relative bypass does not work in this code path.
